grid_import_kwh.name: ImportReading
grid_import_kwh.semantics: cumulative kWh imported from the grid (meter clamp)

grid_export_kwh.name: ExportReading
grid_export_kwh.semantics: cumulative kWh exported to the grid (meter clamp)

home_consumption_kwh.name: load_instant_power_KWh
home_consumption_kwh.semantics: cumulative kWh used by the house (use_kwh of the MySolarBattery app since 23/10/2026)

solar_production_kwh.name: solar_instant_power_KWh
solar_production_kwh.semantics: cumulative kWh produced by the photovoltaic system

battery_charge_kwh.name: battery_charge_power_KWh
battery_charge_kwh.semantics: cumulative kWh charged into the battery

battery_discharge_kwh.name: battery_discharge_power_KWh
battery_discharge_kwh.semantics: cumulative kWh discharged from the battery

limitations: kWh from cumulative counters, as the EmonCMS MySolarBattery app (23/10/2026): house, solar and battery from Tesla (house load_instant_power_KWh 312, same instrument as the battery, so the derived flows add up), grid import and export from emontx3 ImportReading/ExportReading because the Tesla site_instant_power_KWh (313) is the net balance.
emontx3 HomeReading (37) reads about 12 per cent more than the Tesla load on the same days; which one is right needs the utility meter.
EmonCMS metadata leaves most units blank; units were validated against names, ranges and the power balance.
These are operational measurements, not billing-grade meter readings.
